component: K3s embedded etcd and Ethernet DHCP recovery
rootCause: Observed October 15 UTC: obsolete numeric etcd peer and join endpoints survived Ethernet DHCP changes while mDNS remained usable. Stale Node status addresses coincided with network-policy startup loops even after supported configuration was present. Exact onset and external power/WAN causality remain unknown.
resolution: Cold backups, one existing-database seed membership reset per cluster, preserved peer databases, sequential rejoin, supported Ethernet YAML, and guarded seed status correction were reported. Short staging and production checks succeeded; no zero-data-loss or snapshot-restore claim. Prevention and live qualification remain open.
